# registry computed once (soltime_zonetool);  "-" = not yet computed.  Rebuild:  make_zones.pl (see its header).
# Sources:  GeoNames, GHSL UCDB R2024A ((c) European Union), U.S. Census Gazetteer -- see ATTRIBUTION.md
# zone:  the row (0 = the first city) whose clock this city keeps -- its merged zone's most populous city
